name: jscpd
title_zh: 220 种语言里揪出复制粘贴的代码猎犬
tagline_zh: 代码库越大，重复越像杂草。它不靠猜，逐 token 比对，报出重复率与精确位置，重构前先看清哪里在长赘肉。
tagline_en: Big codebases hide duplicated weeds. It compares token-by-token, reports exact locations and duplication.
desc_en: Copy-paste detector for 220+ languages. Detect duplicated code and measure duplication percentages.
why_zh: 不是正则扫相似，而是解析后按 token 流比对，跨文件跨语言都能认，重复率量化到可追踪。
why_en: Not regex fuzz—parses then compares token streams across files and languages. Quantified duplication ratio is CI-gate ready.
limit_zh: 只查复制粘贴型重复，不查语义等价或逻辑克隆；超大仓库首次全量扫描偏慢，需 Node.js 环境。
limit_en: Detects copy-paste only, not semantic clones. Slow on huge repos at first full scan. Needs Node.js. Outputs JSON/HTML—no auto-fix.
